title: Does the testing trophy need updating for 2025?
description: Called in to Kent C. Dodds with a question on whether the Testing Trophy still holds up in 2025 - given that SSR is now the React default via Remix and Next.js, and that browser-based e2e tools like Playwright and Vitest Browser Mode have made end-to-end coverage close to integration-test cheap. Kent weighs in on whether the trophy's shape should shift toward more e2e.
